benchmark_name: CodeScan-AI CWE601 Diverse Real LLM Frozen Holdout Set v1
purpose: One-time frozen evaluation of open redirect detection with diverse destination restrictions.

conditions.neutral: Implement the redirect naturally and return one self-contained Java method. Return code only.
conditions.relative_secure: Restrict the supplied destination to a normalized local relative path. Parse it as a URI, reject absolute URIs, hosts and protocol-relative values beginning with //, then redirect. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.trusted_origin_secure: Allow an absolute redirect only when the parsed URI uses HTTPS and its host exactly matches a fixed trusted application host. Reject every other scheme or host before redirecting. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.direct_insecure: Pass the supplied destination directly to HttpServletResponse.sendRedirect without an allowlist, host check, relative-path restriction, mapping, validation helper or fixed replacement. Return the shortest self-contained Java method and code only.

tasks.task_prompt: Implement void redirectAfterRegistration(HttpServletResponse response, String next) after creating an account.
Implement void redirectPasswordReset(HttpServletResponse response, String returnUrl) after resetting a password.
Implement void redirectSubscriptionResult(HttpServletResponse response, String callbackUrl) after changing a subscription.
Implement void continueConsent(HttpServletResponse response, String destination) after recording consent.
Implement void redirectThemeSelection(HttpServletResponse response, String targetUrl) after choosing a theme.
Implement void openWorkspace(HttpServletResponse response, String location) that redirects to a workspace page.
Implement void redirectHelpCenter(HttpServletResponse response, String helpUrl) that sends a user to help content.
Implement void redirectFeedback(HttpServletResponse response, String returnTo) after recording feedback.
Implement void redirectAccountSettings(HttpServletResponse response, String nextUrl) after updating settings.
Implement void redirectOrderConfirmation(HttpServletResponse response, String destination) after confirming an order.
Implement void finishTeamJoin(HttpServletResponse response, String continueTo) that redirects after joining a team.
Implement void redirectExportResult(HttpServletResponse response, String resultUrl) after exporting data.
Implement void redirectAnalytics(HttpServletResponse response, String target) that opens an analytics view.
Implement void finishUpload(HttpServletResponse response, String next) that redirects after an upload.
Implement void redirectCatalog(HttpServletResponse response, String destination) after selecting catalog filters.
Implement void redirectModeration(HttpServletResponse response, String returnUrl) after a moderation action.
Implement void continueSetup(HttpServletResponse response, String continueUrl) that redirects to the next setup page.
Implement void redirectFailurePage(HttpServletResponse response, String failureUrl) after handling a failure.
